tbpn_example.episode_title: Code Red, AWS CEO Joins, Tae Kim Tells All (Matt Garman, Tae Kim, Tarek Mansour, Matt Mullenweg, Jason Fried)

notes: Research step: John Boyd's OODA loop, developed from Aerial Attack Study (1964) and Energy-Maneuverability theory, formalised in the briefings Patterns of Conflict and The Essence of Winning and Losing (1996). Four phases Observe, Orient, Decide, Act, but the real content is that Orientation is the big outer loop: it is shaped by genetic heritage, cultural tradition, previous experience and new information, and it both filters observation and feeds implicit guidance and control directly to action, bypassing explicit Decide. Boyd's operational claim is not 'be fast' but 'operate inside the adversary's OODA loop' - generate a rapidly changing environment the adversary cannot orient to, so his decisions are answers to a world that has already moved. Common misuse: reading OODA as a tidy four-box sequential cycle (a PDCA lookalike), dropping the orientation feedback arrows and the adversary entirely. Design decision for this framework: model TWO competing actors' loops so that one actor's action node feeds the other actor's observation node, and cycle-time asymmetry is visible. | Scout returned three candidates: (1) Google vs OpenAI Gemini 3 code red 2025-12-02, (2) Meta vs OpenAI comp raid 2025-06-30, (3) Paramount vs Netflix counter-bid 2025-12-09. Chose (1): it is the only candidate where both actors' loops are shown closing on each other across two turns (ChatGPT 2022 -> Google's code red -> a decade of TPUs -> Gemini 3 -> OpenAI's code red), and the cycle-time asymmetry is stated in units on the record (a decade of silicon vs an answer due now). (3) would have duplicated the episode already used by inversion-premortem. | Validator: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Shortened two classic labels (c_s_or2, c_m_lose) to stay inside 40 chars before the scaffold commit. | Design decisions: two interlocking rings, one per actor, actor node at each ring centre with performed_by spokes; idea_bearing_slot is `orientation`, because for OODA the exploitable thing is the blind spot in a rival's filter, and three derived orientation nodes carry `idea` (g_orient, o_or_bench, o_or_subs). | SPEC 3 split rule is demonstrated on OpenAI's orientation: o_or_stated is a FACT node in the orientation slot (Mark Chen's own after-the-fact admission about reasoning vs pre-training), and o_or_bench / o_or_subs are the derived halves the speakers never state. | te20 (o_dec_personalize -> o_act_chen, 0.55) is deliberately below 0.65: the action slot on OpenAI's side has only a public promise inside the two-week window, and the rationale says so.
